text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy complete: service-api v4.0.0 -> canary fleet. initiating post-deploy smoke and synthetic probes. dashboard: https://ci.internal/r/1720001111

jamie: quick FYI, first 5m synthetic kv probe shows small tail increase in latency in ap-southeast. p95 jumped from 220ms to ~760ms at ~1720001300.

rachel: I'm seeing a 0.4% auth error bump on the auth-synth for the same window. not huge but correlated.

tom: pulling sample logs now.

jamie:
```
probe: kv-synth-ap-southeast
window: 2024-10-25T01:05:00Z - 01:10:00Z
p50: 95ms
p95: 220ms -> 760ms
errors: 3/900 (0.3% -> 0.9%)
```

infra-ops: saw two embed-worker pods in ap-southeast-1 restart around 1720001287; kube events show OOMKilled on one.

sre-oncall: adding quick alert: temporary rule to fire at p95 > 500ms or synth errors > 0.8% for canary region.

release-manager: what's current canary weight?

deploy-bot: Canary weight: 25% (auto-step paused until manual ok).

tom: recommendation: pause further rollout, pin ap-southeast to previous model-variant v3.9.8, and keep canary traffic at 25% but route new sessions in ap-southeast to fallback. don't rollback fully yet.

rachel: +1. prefer pin over rollback since other regions look fine.

release-manager: agree. I'll request pin for ap-southeast and annotate release notes: "hold: ap-southeast pin to v3.9.8 pending embed-worker OOM triage."

deploy-bot: Pin applied: ap-southeast -> v3.9.8. routing fallback enabled.

jamie: after pin, p95 down to ~210ms over next 3m. errors back to baseline. monitoring for 30m.

infra-ops: starting rolling bump of embed-worker JVM heaps on the two affected nodes and cordon/drain one suspect node at a time. will report status.

sre-oncall: creating a short-lived dashboard and increased log retention for this thread window. also set temporary incident note.

release-manager: action items: (1) infra-ops triage node OOMs, (2) jamie/rachel watch synths 30m, (3) no rollout increases without manual +1. report back in 25m.

jamie: 25m update: AP-southeast stable for 18m after pin and host fixes. no new OOMs. p95 steady ~200ms. recommend staged resume: 25% -> 50% in 10m after manual confirm, with 15m soak.

release-manager: manual +1 to resume to 50% in 10m, monitor closely. any sign of regressions we revert routing to v3.9.8 and re-pin.

tom: filing a short blameless note to include in deploy retro; also proposing an automated pre-rollout check for embed-worker memory churn on next deploys.

rachel: I'll add a changelog entry: "post-deploy: ap-southeast pinned to v3.9.8 due to localized embed-worker restarts; host fixes applied; resumed rollout after 30m watch."

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout increase to 50% at 1720002200 (in 10m).

release-manager: closing thread for now; reopen on any alerts. thanks for the quick triage. :handshake:
